steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Among lonely graves... Yin and Yang in ceaseless churn...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Come, then go... no soul may stay...
The pale crowd chants in unison, rocking the sails, herding you step by step backward.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>The living stop here... the dead take the river...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>All earthly ties are severed... turn back... and find no shore...

Their features are lost to you. The voices alone remain, thick with a viscous, clinging sorrow, and it seems to dissolve the shapes of them. Their forms are dripping slowly, bleeding into the water below.
Clop. Clop. Clop.
A wooden knocking sounds from nowhere.
Clop. Clop. Clop.
Then...
[Lichen's white silhouette]
There she is, standing tall among the surging crowd. Her cyan sleeves catch the air with effortless grace, impossibly vivid amidst the wash of pale figures.
She turns to you and offers a soft, quiet smile.
Then, without hesitation, she walks straight ahead.
<color=#7683a2><i>Why? Why won't she stop? Why is she walking so fast?
<color=#7683a2><i>Why does it have to be this way?
But even these thoughts soon dissolve. Ash drifts down from all around, and the river quickens, forcing you backward once more.
[White flash transition back to the Surface World]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pant... pant...
You jolt upright, heart pounding, an urgent need to search driving you. Your gaze darts wildly, sweeping every corner for—
Lichen.
She lies nearby, her body left too long on the cold ground. When you touch her, she feels rigid and cold as timber.

You extend your trembling hand, the shaking beyond your will. Fear has seized your body before your heart can catch up. You hover your fingers near her cheek. There is no breath, no heat, no heartbeat. Only stillness.
You move your hand down to her waist.
Nothing comes through from the other end of the shackles.
[Vibration + sound effect]
Furious, you snatch at her robes and yank her body upright from the ground.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Get up... Get up!
Her body sags against your chest, a dead weight. You keep shaking her shoulders with almost violent force, your fingers sinking deep into her cold skin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Get up!!!

You knew she was mad! What made you think words would work? What were you waiting for? You should have hauled her back, no matter if she saw you as an enemy or a hindrance from then on. You knew damn well she was mad!
[2s transition + fabric rustling]
Her arm slides off you, her hand dropping lifelessly into the mud.
You knew it all along.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Lichen.

You catch her limp arm and try to drape it back into place, but your small shoulder won't hold it, and it slips down again. You try once more, then again, until her fingers are coated in fresh mud that hides the dried blood.
Impossible. There must be something you haven't checked, some pulse still flickering, no matter how faint. There must be something.
You bury your face against her chest. The fabric, stiff with dried blood, scrapes your cheek, and the only sound reaching your ears is the drumming of your own heart.
The cold, metallic reek of her blood fills your senses, nearly making you retch. You pull her closer. Her chest grows warm and damp where you press against her. So why can't you hear anything at all?
Across Maria City, the cyan fissures pulse, then close. Under the grey sky, the bare concrete buildings stand silent, as if nothing ever happened.
(Transition 2s)
A hand settles lightly on your shoulder, and the warmth of that touch slowly brings you back.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You're back?
